sources.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads

cards.summary: Google has updated its privacy policy in a way that could mean you'll start seeing targeted ads based on your personal data if you're using personalized AI features. The update, spotted by Android Authority , adds an exception to its promise about not using your Drive, Gmail, or Google Photos for personalized ads.
cards.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads

sources.title: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say

cards.summary: Meta has tweaked its business terms to remove language suggesting that it could freely train its AI models on news sites, like The Verge - but legal experts say these changes aren't enough to address their concerns. "This does nothing to restrict the 'associated with your products or services' [language] that would let Meta scrape entire sites," James Grimmelmann, a professor of digital and information law at Cornell Law School, tells Nieman Lab .
cards.title: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
